contract.sync_assumed: the whole hardware warp calls the primitive together (all logical warps at once), as the harness does
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one any-vote over the full hardware warp, no barrier
contract.type_constraints: bf16 keys only, two rows of N keys per call packed as bf16x2 words (row 0 in the low half, row 1 in the high half of word j = item j LW + lane), int32 source indices derived from the position, output row r's k indices at out_idx[r K, (r + 1) K). fp32 keys unsupported (two do not fit one register)
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN key is never selected (it loses every max.bf16x2 and min.bf16x2 against a number and both set.gt and set.eq are false), so with fewer than k non-NaN keys output slots stay unwritten. Focus-set inputs carry no NaN. -0.0 equals +0.0: the network orders -0.0 below +0.0, the recovery classifies by IEEE comparison, the selected set is the oracle's set in every case (signed_zero pattern passes under both requirements). Denormals compared as values
contract.tie_break_support: both unsorted requirements with the same code: the tie class at the k-th key fills the remaining slots, in index order whenever it has to be capped (prefer_smaller_index exact by construction), measured identical throughput under both requirements in every cell
contract.sorted_output_support: none: the greater class is written in lane order, then the tie class (lane order on the common path, index order on the capped path). A sorted output would need one shuffle per selected key to move the recovered index to its network position
contract.k_range: [1, N / 2] with MaxK = round_up(k, LW) dividing N, measured k 4, 16, 32, 64
contract.n_range: N = LW x IPT with N / MaxK a power of two, measured N 32 to 256 at LW 32 (two rows of N per call, so 64 to 512 keys per call)

correctness.notes: Oracle battery (13 cases: the cell's random seeds plus tie_heavy, sorted_asc, sorted_desc, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm, quantized_random, relu_quantized) passed on every cell under both requirements, every row of the two-row input checked on its own by the harness 0.5 rows oracle. Control W1x_vimnmx_eager (the T42 one-word min max network, one row per call) in the same lock section, the W2_packed_v3 control in a second lock section of the same lease (batch b3w2) merged into this card. The card's cells are the final commit 8f613a317f (batch b3), the development batches b1 (ops_sel exchange, 3ede7791e3) and b2 (ops_bf16, 30f5b8f821) are under state/results/opt-N5/ and quoted in the findings. Gelem per s counts 2 N elements per call (both rows). prefer_smaller_index and not_guaranteed share the common path but compile to different kernels in the fast form (the exact ballot fallback is compiled in for prefer_smaller_index, the capped prefix for not_guaranteed), and the prefer_smaller_index kernel carries 3 to 16 more registers and runs 2 to 4 percent slower in throughput in most cells (up to 9 percent at LW 8 N 128), a T28 schedule and register effect of code that never executes on random input. The exact form compiles the same code for both requirements and measured identical throughput to 0.1 percent.

low_level: Exchange codegen: `k = keep_max ? hmax2(k, o) : hmin2(k, o)` with the asm calls inside the ternary compiles to two predicated HMNMX2.BF16_V2 writing the same register (153 HMNMX2 for 75 stage words at N 128 k 32, the shape of the control's 153 VIMNMX), the form that computes both results and selects compiles to the HMNMX2 pair plus a predicated IMAD.MOV per stage word (576 against 528 SASS instructions in the N 128 k 32 two-row throughput kernel, 445 against 458 Gelem per s in consecutive sections against the same control), and the predicate inside one asm block is worst (424 against 352 in the split kernel). The if-converted form rebuilds the direction predicate every stage (ISETP 67 and LOP3 47 against 5 and 24 in the control, which keeps its predicates hoisted in P registers), about half a half-rate instruction per stage. Catalogue entry T53, micro approaches/N5/micro/exchange_forms.cu.

Registers and occupancy of the throughput kernel (256 threads): 30 to 32 at N 32 (8 blocks per SM), 36 to 40 at N 64 (6), 47 to 48 at N 128 (5 to 6), 48 to 59 at N 256 (4 to 5). The ternary exchange form costs 16 registers over the select form at N 128 (32 to 48) and three blocks per SM, and still wins 3 percent throughput. No spill, no stack frame, no STL or LDL in any kernel of any cell (T36 checked in both kernels of every TU).

The index recovery is about a third of the two-row kernel: 8 HSET2 (one set.gt and one set.eq per word, per-half masks, T18), 4 LOP3 plus IADD3 for the per-lane counts, a 5-step shuffle scan with the four counts in 8-bit fields (N at most 255, two 16-bit scans at N 256), one broadcast shuffle, then per packed word about 20 instructions (two predicates by LOP3 to P and ISETP against 0xffff, two predicated STS with IMAD addresses, two predicated increments per class). The two-class ballot form of the exact recovery adds 2 VOTE and 4 POPC per word (N5_rows: 4 to 8 percent slower from N 128 on, equal below).

SASS instruction counts of the throughput kernels at k 32: N 32 216, N 64 352, N 128 592 (both paths of the fast form compiled, the common path about 500), N 256 1096 for two rows, against the control's 192, 312, 336, 600 for one row (harness loop included). SHFL 82 against 75 at N 128 (75 stage shuffles plus 5 scan plus 2 broadcast and total), both kernels have no BSSY except the one uniform fallback region of the fast form.

T47 explains the gap between the instruction ratio and the throughput ratio: min, max, LOP3 and HSET2 all issue at half rate, the shuffle unit at one per SM per cycle, so the network stage is pipe bound from two warps per scheduler and the half-rate recovery instructions (HSET2, LOP3) and the per-stage predicate LOP3 count against the same pipe as the exchange. The two-row stage issues 2 HMNMX2 plus about 1 predicate instruction plus 1 shuffle for two keys against 2 VIMNMX plus about 0.3 predicate plus 1 shuffle for one key.
algorithmic: Two rows per lane pay off because every shuffle and every min or max of the network serves two keys at once while the per-row cost of the index path is bounded by N (one HSET2 pair per word, a scan per call, about 20 instructions per packed word): the card's model of half the shuffles and half the ALU per row holds for the network, and the recovery takes back about a third of it. Measured against the T42 one-word min max network in the same session (b2, Gelem per s, both requirements identical): N 32 k 4 to 16 393 against 270 (1.46x), N 64 k 4 to 32 405 against 328 to 331 (1.22x to 1.24x), N 128 k 4 to 32 477 against 356 to 358 (1.33x to 1.34x), N 128 k 64 436 against 302 (1.44x), N 256 k 4 to 32 511 to 514 against 363 to 367 (1.39x to 1.42x), N 256 k 64 452 against 248 (1.82x). Against the card's reference W1_eager_same (268 at N 128 k 32, measured 268 in the same session as b1): 1.78x. Against W2_packed_v3's card value at N 256 k 32 (332): 1.54x, same-session W2 cells in this card.

Where the gain grows: k 64 (two words per tile, M 2) gains most (1.44x to 1.82x) because the one-word control's in-register exchanges and its 48-register tier (5 blocks per SM) hurt it while the two-row kernel's recovery is k independent. N 32 gains 1.46x because the control's single-tile kernel is dominated by the per-call harness and emission work that the two-row form halves per row. N 64 gains least (1.22x): the two-tile network is short and the scan's fixed cost (about 25 instructions) weighs most against it.

Index recovery form: the fast path (both classes by the lane scan, every equal key written when the tie class fits the remaining slots, a hardware-warp-uniform any-vote decides) beats the exact form (ballot rank per word) by 4 to 8 percent from N 128 on and ties below. The fallback runs on 0 of 16 random inputs per cell at k at least 16 and on the battery's tie patterns, where it is exact by construction (index-ordered ballot rank for prefer_smaller_index, capped lane prefix for not_guaranteed).

The single-row split form (N5_split_f, same session) reaches 0.95x to 1.09x at N 64 to 128 and 1.24x to 1.26x at N 256 (k at most 32) and 1.19x to 1.66x at k 64 against the same control: the one-word final merge and the half-filled SIMD words of a split row cost 15 to 25 points against the two-row form. It is a drop-in for a single-row API and clears the card's 370 at N 128 k 32 (387), the two-row form is the primitive that clears every threshold with margin.

Latency regime (reported, not the target): two rows in 774 to 2367 cycles against one row in 512 to 1718 (0.61x to 0.75x per call, 1.2x to 1.6x per row), the split row 1.1x to 1.5x slower than the one-word row below N 256 and 0.92x at N 256 k at most 32. The network's dependent chain is the same length per stage, the recovery adds a dependent scan and ballot tail, so the latency regime is the one-word network's as the card predicted.
negative: The asm-predicated exchange (`setp` plus `@p max.bf16x2` plus `@!p min.bf16x2` in one asm block, ops_pred) is the worst of the three forms: the predicate is materialized around every asm block (SEL, ISETP, IMAD.MOV), 424 against 352 SASS instructions in the N 128 k 32 split kernel, not measured on the GPU.

Precomputed lane-bit parity words for the stage direction (net_dir, N5_rows_fd) change nothing: identical ISETP count (90) and 600 against 592 instructions, the per-stage predicate cost is the if-conversion's, not the direction arithmetic's. Not measured on the GPU.

Negating the partner operand (neg.bf16x2 or an xor of the sign bits) to turn the exchange into one unconditional max is not folded into HMNMX2 by ptxas (168 against 144 instructions in the micro), so the sign-convention trick that would make the exchange one instruction plus one LOP3 does not exist on this toolchain.

Carrying a 16-bit index per key in a second register with an HSET2 mask and a LOP3 blend costs 2 shuffles plus 4 half-rate instructions per stage word for two rows, exactly the one-word route's 2 shuffles plus 4 VIMNMX for two rows (the card's own model), so the index-carrying form was not built: keys only plus recovery is the only form with a gain.

The exact recovery's two ballots per word for the tie class cost 4 to 8 percent at N 128 and above against the scan-only common path (b2: 458 against 477 at N 128 k 32, 477 against 511 at N 256 k 32).
surprises: ptxas folds the select of max.u32 and min.u32 results into a predicated VIMNMX pair but not the select of max.bf16x2 and min.bf16x2 (or max.u16x2 and min.u16x2) results, which get a predicated IMAD.MOV instead. Writing the SIMD calls inside the ternary makes the front end keep a branch (an asm result is not speculatable) that ptxas if-converts into the predicated pair, at the cost of rebuilding the predicate per stage.

The ternary form raised the kernel's registers from 32 to 48 at N 128 (occupancy 8 to 5 blocks per SM) and the throughput still rose 3 percent, consistent with T47's pipe-bound stage from two warps per scheduler.

The k 64 cells gain the most (1.82x at N 256) although the card expected the gain to shrink as the per-row network grows: the control's 48-register tier and in-register exchanges at M 2 cost it more than the two-row kernel's k-independent recovery.

The harness 0.5 rows-per-group path (packed_rows, per-row oracle, 2 N elements per call) existed before the question reached the evaluation engineer, so the two-row primitive was measured as the card describes it without a harness change.

prefer_smaller_index and not_guaranteed share the common path but compile to different kernels in the fast form (the exact ballot fallback is compiled in for prefer_smaller_index, the capped prefix for not_guaranteed), and the prefer_smaller_index kernel carries 3 to 16 more registers and runs 2 to 4 percent slower in throughput in most cells (up to 9 percent at LW 8 N 128), a T28 schedule and register effect of code that never executes on random input. The exact form compiles the same code for both requirements and measured identical throughput to 0.1 percent.
open_questions: Whether a maxrregcount 32 build (8 blocks per SM for the ternary form) gains anything, given T47's pipe bound from two warps per scheduler.

T51's truncated final merge (stop at stride k, k-th key by redux) for two bf16 rows: two integer reductions on twiddled halves (about 10 instructions) against the 5 saved stages (about 18) at k 32, a 2 to 3 percent model gain, not built.

A one-class pass per T52's one-ballot form (one set.ge per word when the group holds exactly k keys at least t) would remove one HSET2 and one count per word, 4 to 8 instructions per packed word, not built.

Whether the per-stage predicate rebuild (about 0.5 half-rate instruction per stage) can be avoided by a ptxas peephole for the bf16x2 selp, or by a C++ form nvcc speculates (none found: the header intrinsics are inline asm too).
A sorted-output variant (one shuffle per selected key to place the recovered index at the network position) was not built, the card's cells are unsorted.

T53 codegen confirmed in the rebuilt N 128 k 32 not_guaranteed throughput kernel: 592 instructions, 82 SHFL, 153 HMNMX2 of which 150 are predicated pairs writing one register (`@!P0 HMNMX2.BF16_V2 R23` then `@P0 HMNMX2.BF16_V2 R23`, the 3 unpredicated ones are the tile pair maxes), 26 IMAD.MOV none of them at an exchange, 8 HSET2, 90 ISETP, 32 STS (both rows, common and capped path), against the control's 336 with 75 SHFL and 153 VIMNMX. The micro exchange_forms.cu recompiled on the node gives the catalogue's counts exactly (u32 128, bf16x2 ternary 144 with 50 predicated, select 152 with 27 IMAD.MOV, u16x2 144 and 152, blend 152, negated operand 168). Statements checked against the cells: prefer_smaller_index runs 0.5 percent faster to 2.8 percent slower than not_guaranteed in throughput at warp scope (within the stated 0 to 4 percent) and 8.1 percent slower in latency at N 256 k 16 and 32 (2502 against 2315), the two-row call costs 1.34x to 1.67x the one-row call in latency (N 32 1.67x, N 256 k 32 1.35x, N 256 k 64 1.60x). Text slips, not number errors: the latency finding quotes the exact form's b2 cycles (774 to 2367) instead of this card's own (855 to 2315), the contract field tie_break_support says "measured identical throughput under both requirements in every cell", which is the exact form's statement and is contradicted by this card's own correctness notes and by the cells (the prefer_smaller_index kernel compiles the ballot fallback, 632 against 592 instructions and 3 to 16 more registers), and the card carries the W2_packed_v3 control for not_guaranteed only (the rerun's prefer_smaller_index cells against W2 are 471.7 to 499.9, same picture). Same node as the card, no cross-node measurement, these are small kernels (at most 2.5 k SASS instructions at warp scope). Verified.
